info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Internal Bank Account Retrieval API
info.description: The Internal Bank Account Retrieval API enables users to access detailed information about internal bank accounts within the operational banking services framework. By utilizing the account identifier, consumers can fetch pertinent account data, facilitating insights for financial operations and decision-making. This API is particularly useful for internal financial analysts, operational teams, and audit departments seeking to streamline banking data access and enhance transparency. It supports efficient account management and alignment with compliance requirements.

get.description: This endpoint allows clients to fetch detailed information about a specific internal bank account using its unique account identifier. Utilize this resource to view account status, balance, and other pertinent details.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving information about the internal bank account identified by ACC-200045. This request should provide the necessary parameters to obtain the relevant account details.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the account details.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses JSON Web Tokens (JWT) for authentication. The client must include a valid JWT in the Authorization header of the HTTP request in the format: 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'. Ensure that the token has not expired and meets the required permissions for the requested resource.
